name: NX Android Streamer
tagline: Your PC is the phone, your phone is the glass — stream a full Android that feels native

artifacts.label: Server rig (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: One-time setup needs root for Waydroid: from the install directory run './start.sh setup', then './start.sh arm', then once './start.sh doctor' (fixes networking + adb). After that, Launch boots the Android session AND starts streaming — the card shows live status while it runs, and Stop shuts it down.
